searchText: anyone know of efforts here? https://twitter.com/sendmoodz/status/1461414371498864642?s=20 Why? We have normal memory that's transient and chaper than storage https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1153 I bet he didn't even bother to search first. The wish there is to make it persistent across calls in a transaction. The common usage is a "call mutex" to protect reentrancy. The storage net cost was suppose to allow such use cases. IIRC, if you change a storage value X -> Y -> X to total cost should be 3x SLOAD (the storage modification cancels out).
